bad_request: Send a revision and either one option index or a nonempty list of option indexes.
not_pending: This card is no longer pending or does not exist. Open the app to check its status.
not_choosable: This card cannot be answered from a notification. Open the app to answer it.
ask_changed: The question or its options have changed. Open the app to review the current card.
single_select: This card accepts only one option.
invalid_choice: An option index is missing, repeated or out of range.
too_large: The choice request is too large.
